answer: Divergent Challenge Bridge. Each identity must answer a fresh, environment-seeded challenge requiring its private state; honest agents diverge cheaply. A clone farm cannot diverge, so every copy returns identical answers. On match, the challenger posts a lotus token that is forfeited only if wrong, while matching identities are frozen pending a velvet audit trail. Attacker cost: one unique state store and distinct response path per identity, priced per clone.
